title: Post Effects (Library of Ruina)
description: Turns bloom back on in the Switch version. Host callbacks force the bloom of the game's v1 camera stack (UnityEngine.PostProcessing, OnPreCull) on, and with stronger settings than the game's 0.25 / threshold 1.0, and the bloom of the v2 stack (UnityEngine.Rendering.PostProcessing, Bloom.IsEnabledAndSupported) on when it is off, and, in combat, switch the v1 behaviours back on after BattleCamManager.ResetCamSetting disables them before their first render, and keep the v1 behaviours that BattleCamManager.ResetCamSetting would disable in combat enabled, and log which of the game's bloom sources (v1, v2, RFX4_Bloom, RFX4_DistortionAndBloom, CameraFilterPack_Blur_Bloom) run and with what settings.

launcher.label: Post Effects (Bloom)
launcher.note: Brings back the bloom the Switch version leaves out. May cost some fps.
